input:
Traditional tale: 神农尝百草

Earlier scenes:
(none)

This scene:
在古代，很多医生不知道怎么用药。所以他们找到了很多植物对药。神农先看到很多病人，他们吃很多植物对药。但是我觉得他们的吃的植物，让他们病人。神农觉得这个植物可能特别是毒。所以他想找一个植物对药，他们可以吃对药。正好，他找到了一把花，他想把花放在茶里，对药。

Expressiveness ideas:
1. When describing the patients, add a physical symptom to show their suffering: “很多病人吃了有毒的植物，肚子疼得直冒汗。”
2. At the point where Shen Nong decides to search, add his inner thought or quoted speech: “神农想：我一定要找出能治病的植物。”
3. When the flowers appear, add a visual detail so the setting is easier to imagine: “那些花是黄色的，像星星一样，又大又漂亮。”

ideas.reason: It adds a concrete symptom that fits the patients becoming ill after eating poisonous plants.
The learner already says that Shennong wants to find a medicinal plant people can eat.
It adds an easy visual detail about the flowers without changing the story.
